[Code Reviewer], please perform the final review of task 264 (Brain Bridge resolves the active project root for the context bundle and file-pull tools — GitHub issue 24).

Status: implementation staged, QA returned QA_PASSED (adversarial audit, no reproducible defect; 5 adversarial angles cleared, 3 non-blocking observations O1-O3). The changed hunks ride with this turn (include_diff=True), and the task file's Execution Log now carries the QA turn outcome.
